title: buddleja tibetica var. truncatifolia
intro: Buddleja tibetica var. truncatifolia, commonly known as the dwarf Tibetan butterfly bush, is a perennial plant species in the Buddleja genus, known for its compact growth habit and vibrant blue-purple flowers. Traditionally, the plant is used in herbal medicine, and it is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Buddleja tibetica var. truncatifolia include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to relieve congestion and soothe the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
